title: TokenCap
description: TokenCap is a local-first developer tool that generates AI-ready snapshots of your codebase including dependency graphs, context memory, and Git-aware file selection. Works offline. Never uploads your code.
ogTitle: TokenCap: Compress your codebase for AI handoffs
ogDescription: Generate structured, AI-ready snapshots of your project in seconds. Dependency graph, context memory, Git diffs, secret redaction. Local-first. Free. Open source.
